patterns.css: @keyframes stagger-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0,-8px,0) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateZ(0) } }
@keyframes fade-up { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(1rem) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) } }
@keyframes fade-up-sm { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0.375rem) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) } }
@keyframes fade-up-md { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0.625rem) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) } }
@keyframes depth-50 { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateZ(-50px) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateZ(0) } }
@keyframes depth-200 { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateZ(-200px) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateZ(0) } }
@keyframes depth-500 { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateZ(-500px) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateZ(0) } }
@keyframes scale-in-sm { 0% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.93) } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) } }
@keyframes spring-pop { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1) } }
@keyframes toast-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0.5rem) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) } }
@keyframes toast-out { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) } to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-1rem) } }
@keyframes idle-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) } 50% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(1.15) } }
